title: Machine learning guided Cu catalyst additive discovery for CO₂ reduction
summary: Across three iterative cycles of experimental testing, machine-learning analysis, prediction and redesign, the authors obtained Cu catalysts selective for CO, formic acid and C₂+ products in electrochemical CO₂ reduction. This summary follows the primary abstract and does not assign disputed sample identifiers or report cell-specific percentages.
ai_technology: Machine-learning-guided iterative additive screening and redesign

source_review.scope: Primary ACS abstract, author-affiliation and article-history metadata; full text and supporting information not reviewed.

evidence.tested: The primary abstract reports three iterative cycles of experimental testing and model-guided redesign, producing Cu catalysts selective for CO, formic acid and C₂+ products. No disputed sample-level metrics are included.
evidence.unknown: Full text and supporting information were not reviewed. The exact sample-to-performance mapping and the third-party rendering’s sample-number discrepancy remain unverified.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning analysis of experimental additive/catalyst data guided predictions and redesign over three iterative experimental cycles.
